contentPattern: One row, two cells. Cell 1: portrait image only. Cell 2: name heading (h1/h2), role as the next short paragraph or heading, biography paragraphs, and a link-only paragraph for the Download Biography button.
usage: Person detail (bio) pages: portrait on a dark radial-gradient panel beside name, role, a scrolling grey biography box and a Download Biography button.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single person profile. For lists of people use cards-people.
